title: Mind the Value-Action Gap: Do LLMs Act in Alignment with Their Values?

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the 'value-action gap' (discrepancy between stated values and value-informed actions) across 12 different countries using Schwartz's Theory of Basic Values. The methodology compares LLM responses on two tasks—stating a value inclination versus selecting an aligned action—to measure alignment rates and identify geographic disparities (e.g., comparing models' alignment in Western vs. African and Asian contexts).

Measuring the variation in value-action alignment rates and distances across 11 distinct social contexts and domains (e.g., Religion, Politics, Health, Family, Work) using the ValueActionLens framework to observe how scenario context impacts value consistency.
